g.text: Rate-ratio lag profile, negative-binomial model -- Holm-Bonferroni survivor pairs

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4c4c4c

g.text: A pair significant at most tested lags is more consistent with both populations tracking a shared, slowly-varying context (fixation, stimulus presence) than with a lag-specific coupling, which should instead peak near a small number of adjacent lags.
